text:
Transmission Means | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the Isusu car 
 pick up inspection steps I2, which must be carried out every 1000 km.
The car technical data:
 Type: Isusu Car Pickup, 
 No. of Engine: 432 , 
 Chassis : 7156784 , 
 Wight : I,46 Ton
The first draft 
 initiated by eng. Mohamed Alaa Eldin, tested by eng. Aiman Mohamed Shabana 
 and revised by EDEPC quality control eng. Samir Abdel Gilel, accepted by 
 general director eng. Mohamed Nageb and approved by eng. Mostafa Alam Head 
 Sector of Talkha PS 2x210 MW
Safety 
Precaution
Safety Belt must be on.
Fire Chimney must be on.
Jake for tires.
Tools and 
Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set .
Cleaning fluid .
Rag wipe, Screw drivers.
Work to be Carried out
Change oil .
Check exhaust pipes and moanting .
Check steering system for looseness or damage.
Check universal joints and sleeves.
Clean air cleaner by compressed air to the 
 element from in side while turning the element by hand.
Check the level of brake fluid
Check the level of clutch fluid
Check chassisspring for damage.
Check steering wheel play and for looseness in 
 mount.
Check wipe glasses.
